rationales: scan_typescript now mixes test discovery, selection markers, assertion noops, and the new expect-chain noop scan in one reading. Extracting the TS_EXPECT_CALL loop into a typescript_expect_noops generator keeps one step per function and makes the expect grammar independently testable.
behaviorRisks: must preserve marker emission order (expect markers appended after the assert markers, before the TestFile return) and the exact message 'new constant or self-comparing expect assertion'

rationales: mask_c_like builds code and comparison_view in lockstep; the comment and code branches append identical content to both lists, so a future token type must remember to update both. A local append-both helper reduces the chance of updating only one view, which the length guard catches only at runtime.
behaviorRisks: none; both views must stay byte-identical in length and offsets, already verified by the length guard

findings.refactoring: Extract Function into a test helper, e.g. _assert_typescript_assertion_passes(assertion)
rationales: Four new pass-case tests (test_typescript_different_expect_values_pass, test_typescript_different_literal_whitespace_passes, test_typescript_non_pure_equality_calls_pass, test_typescript_identity_assertions_with_allocated_literals_pass) repeat the identical body: build base/head trees from TS_TEST.replace("assert.ok(value)", assertion), run_check, and assert exit code 0. Extracting the body leaves each test owning only its data tuple, so a new pass case is a one-line entry instead of a full method.
behaviorRisks: Each subTest must keep its exact assertion string, the identical base/head tree construction, and the assertEqual(code, 0) check.

findings.refactoring: Extract Function into a test helper, e.g. _assert_typescript_assertion_fails(assertion)
rationales: Three new fail-case tests (test_typescript_template_and_member_self_comparisons_fail, test_typescript_expect_trailing_commas_fail, test_typescript_deep_equality_and_pure_operands_fail) repeat the identical body: build trees, run_check, assert exit code 1 and ": V5:" in output. Extracting the body makes each test a data-only entry and keeps the V5 assertion defined once.
behaviorRisks: Each subTest must keep its exact assertion string and the identical assertEqual(code, 1) plus assertIn(": V5:", out) checks.

findings.refactoring: Extract Function into a test helper, e.g. _assert_python_runtime_skip_fails(imports, call, expect_not_v4=False)
rationales: The change adds the second and third copies of the runtime-skip fail body: test_imported_pytest_skip_aliases_fail and test_wildcard_pytest_runtime_skips_fail repeat test_runtime_python_skips_fail's build-trees/run_check/assert-code-1/assertIn-V3 body, differing only in inputs and whether assertNotIn(": V4:", out) is asserted. A helper with an optional V4 flag removes the triplicated body and makes the V3/V4 contract live in one place.
behaviorRisks: Keep the exact imports/call strings and preserve per-test assertions, including assertNotIn(": V4:", out) only where it currently appears (test_runtime_python_skips_fail and test_imported_pytest_skip_aliases_fail).
